title: Redux Testing
description: Learn how to test Redux reducers, actions, and React components.
longDescription: Redux's pure-function architecture makes it highly testable. This module covers unit testing reducers, testing React components connected to Redux, and testing async logic like thunks. You'll write meaningful tests that catch bugs before they reach production while keeping test suites fast and maintainable.
whatYouLearn: Test async thunks with mocked APIs
Assert on dispatched actions and state changes
Keep Redux tests fast and deterministic
